mechanism: Both agents inhibit CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, potentially increasing colchicine levels and toxicity risk; turmeric may also potentiate colchicine's anti-inflammatory effects leading to additive GI effects.
action: Monitor for colchicine toxicity (diarrhea, myopathy, neuropathy); consider dose reduction or increased monitoring if concurrent use is necessary; counsel patients on GI symptom reporting.
